A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same VGGT-Segmentor work. Pages 2–11 have identical text and rendered images. Neither PDF contains appendices; separate Supplementary Material referenced in both is unavailable and cannot be compared.

before.justification: v1 reports original VGGT-S evaluations on Ego–Exo4D and MvMHAT, component and sensitivity ablations, inference timings, and qualitative segmentation results in Section 4.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–2 and ablations in Tables 3–8.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same frozen VGGT encoder, three-stage Union Segmentation Head, iterative refinement, and single-image self-supervised training procedure.

E1.justification: SA-1B pretraining and Ego–Exo4D/MvMHAT evaluations are unchanged. Both also retain the same brief MAVREC outdoor-testing statement, whose details are deferred to unavailable supplementary material.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–2, including ObjectRelator and DOMR on Ego–Exo4D and MvMHAT and DOMR on MvMHAT.

E3.justification: The official Ego–Exo4D split, IoU/AP metrics, 12-epoch training schedule, one-epoch MvMHAT fine-tuning, model configurations, and inference-timing procedure remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 3–8 retain identical component, fusion-resolution, point-count, refinement-iteration, input-size, and decoder-depth ablations. The diagnostic and qualitative examples in Figures 1, 3, and 4 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training-seed counts, repeated-training-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Both retain the same point-estimate reporting and averaging of inference time over 100 forward passes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings are unchanged. Table 1 retains supervised IoUs of 67.7%/68.0% and zero-shot IoUs of 54.1%/58.4%; Table 2 retains 80.7% AP for VGGT-S on MvMHAT.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(20) are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The proposed contributions, state-of-the-art performance claim, and correspondence-free generalization claim retain the same meaning and scope. Abbreviating 'state-of-the-art' to 'SOTA' in the abstract does not change the claim.

C2.justification: The explanations of geometric alignment, projection-drift correction, generalization, and accuracy–latency tradeoffs are identical. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: The v3 abstract newly states that code is publicly available and supplies the buaa-colalab/VGGT-S repository link. This adds code-access information; implementation details and hyperparameters are unchanged. Repository contents cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 55 references, and the positioning relative to prior geometric modeling and cross-view segmentation work are unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract corrects 'textntion' to 'attention', removes 'exceptionally', abbreviates 'state-of-the-art' to 'SOTA', and adds the code-availability sentence. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; the remaining prose and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: The first-page abstract has slight line reflow and an added blue repository link, alongside the updated arXiv stamp. All four figures, eight tables, captions, and page layouts on pages 2–11 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v3 corrects an abstract typo and adds an explicit repository link, modestly improving clarity and code discoverability. The method, empirical evidence, and conclusions are unchanged. The improvement is limited to presentation and access documentation; code completeness and functionality cannot be assessed from the supplied PDFs.
